from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional, List

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, model_validator, SerializeAsAny
from sqlalchemy import Boolean, Column, DateTime, String, inspect, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from sqlalchemy.types import JSON

from asr_service.backends.base_options import BaseOptions
from asr_service.constants import PRESET_TYPE
from asr_service.presets.preset_pipeline import PresetPipeline
from asr_service.backends import BACKENDS
from shared.lib.backend import Backend


class Preset(BaseModel):
    id: str = Field(..., description="Name of the preset")
    label: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Human-readable label of the preset")
    base: Optional[str] = Field(..., description="Base model variant for the preset")
    type: PRESET_TYPE = Field('transcribe', description="Type of the preset, can be 'transcribe', 'translate' or 'realtime'")
    default: Optional[bool] = Field(False, description="Is this the default preset?")
    mutable: Optional[bool] = Field(True, description="Is this preset muteable?")
    options: Optional[List[SerializeAsAny[BaseOptions]]] = Field(default=None, description="Preset options")

    def create_pipeline(self):
        return PresetPipeline(self.id, self.options)

    @model_validator(mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _parse_options(cls, data: dict) -> dict:
        is_dict = False
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            is_dict = True
            root_base = data.get("base") or None
            raw_options = data.get("options") or []
        elif getattr(data, 'base', None) and getattr(data, 'options', None):
            root_base = data.base or None
            raw_options = data.options or []
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid preset: {data}")
        parsed = []
        for value in raw_options:
            if isinstance(value, BaseOptions):
                parsed.append(value)
                continue
            if not isinstance(value, dict) or "process_type" not in value:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing 'process_type' in options")
            process_type = value["process_type"]
            base = root_base if "base" not in value else value["base"]
            entry = next(
                (entry for entry in BACKENDS if entry.process_type == process_type and entry.name == base), None
            )
            if entry is None:
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid preset options: {value}")
            model_cls = entry.options_type
            if model_cls:
                parsed.append(model_cls.model_validate(value))
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid options: {value}")
        if is_dict:
            data["options"] = parsed
        else:
            data.options = parsed
        return data

class PresetDB(Backend.Base):
    __tablename__ = 'preset'

    id = Column(String(64), primary_key=True, unique=True, nullable=False)
    label = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    base = Column(String(64), index=True, nullable=True)
    type = Column(String(16), index=True, nullable=False, default='transcribe')
    default = Column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=False)

import logging
from typing import Optional, List

from shared.lib.backend import Backend
from .preset import Preset, PresetDB
from .preset_pipeline import PresetPipeline


class PresetManager:
    _instance: Optional["PresetManager"] = None

    def __init__(self):
        self._presets: List[Preset] = []
        self.logger: logging.Logger = None
        raise RuntimeError("Call instance() instead")

    @classmethod
    def instance(cls) -> "PresetManager":
        if cls._instance is None:
            obj = cls.__new__(cls)
            obj._presets = []
            obj.logger = logging.getLogger("PresetManager")
            cls._instance = obj
        return cls._instance

    def load_all(self):
        with Backend.instance().db_session() as db:
            persisted = PresetDB.all(db)

        # Database entries are the latest values for presets that were edited
        # through the API. Keep configuration-only presets as well, and avoid
        # adding the same id more than once.
        existing_by_id = {preset.id: preset for preset in self._presets}
        for preset in persisted:
            existing = existing_by_id.get(preset.id)
            if existing is None:
                self._presets.append(preset)
            else:
                # ``mutable`` is not persisted; retain the configuration
                # value when replacing an existing preset.
                preset.mutable = existing.mutable
                self._presets[self._presets.index(existing)] = preset

    def save_all(self):
        with Backend.instance().db_session() as db:
            for preset in self._presets:
                PresetDB.save(db, preset)

    def save_one(self, preset: Preset):
        with Backend.instance().db_session() as db:
            PresetDB.save(db, preset)

    def upsert_preset(self, preset: Preset):
        """Add or replace a preset in the in-memory list and persist it.

        Modifying an existing preset preserves its ``mutable`` flag, so a
        config-provided (immutable) preset stays undeletable after an edit.
        """
        existing_index = next(
            (i for i, existing in enumerate(self._presets) if existing.id == preset.id),
            None,
        )
        if existing_index is None:
            self._presets.append(preset)
        else:
            # Preserve the flag from the existing entry, including for
            # config-provided (immutable) presets edited through the API.
            preset.mutable = self._presets[existing_index].mutable
            self._presets[existing_index] = preset
        self.save_one(preset)

    def remove_preset(self, preset_id: str) -> bool:
        """Remove a preset from the in-memory list and the DB. Returns whether it existed.

        Immutable presets (``mutable is False``) cannot be deleted.
        """
        preset = next((p for p in self._presets if p.id == preset_id), None)
        if preset is not None and preset.mutable is False:
            raise PermissionError(f"Preset '{preset_id}' is immutable and cannot be deleted")
        existed = preset is not None
